scope: One complete Chinese action-directing photography course in existing /learning; no new skill system, production deployment, personal-data change or business-code edits by Verifier.

statuses.PASS: Actual evidence satisfies all applicable observable requirements; human learning remains separately unverified.
statuses.REVISE: A reproducible content/evidence or implementation defect violates a frozen requirement; return only actionable failure to responsible agent.
statuses.BLOCKED: Necessary capability or source evidence is absent, or two directed revision rounds failed; retain artifacts and exact limitations.
statuses.UNVERIFIED: No actual evidence from this run; never replace with an agent SUCCESS or historical test.

criteria.requirement: A continuous complete Chinese course named 动作导演 opens in existing /learning, with a discoverable course entry and local runnable opening instructions; existing reader/data/source mechanisms are reused with bounded adaptation.
criteria.evidence: Inspect candidate course and actual desktop HTTP navigation, opening entry and deep link; inspect final diff against baseline.

criteria.requirement: Course explains intent from character/clothing/props/site, observable diagnosis of weight/body facing/hands/gaze/occlusion/camera position, concrete executable direction, slow tasks or transition for inexperienced models, reshoot keep/change decisions and side effects, and safe alternatives under props/wig/wide sleeves/crowds/site limits.
criteria.evidence: Independent close reading maps actual passages to these judgments; coverage labels alone do not pass.

criteria.requirement: At least one worked teaching chain moves from explicit goal and visible problem through a sayable specific direction, refilm/review criterion, and tradeoff or concurrent-variable limitation. At least one meaningful nonweapon portrait or cosplay directing situation exists; sword perspective is not the whole module.
criteria.evidence: Identify exact chapter/case passages and original visual basis. Distinguish photographed change from proposed transfer practice; do not invent a corrected photo.

criteria.requirement: Research makes a documented effort to obtain reliable firsthand material from at least two independent photographers, prioritizing a real BTS/video with visible adjustment. Record who actually read each source, URLs/locators/timestamps, access failures and source independence. Two names, titles, search summaries or views do not constitute evidence.
criteria.evidence: Inspect original process/tool records and source artifacts; independently access the important original materials. If fewer are usable, record the gap without pretending the stated research goal was fully verified.

criteria.requirement: Every important visual case claim corresponds to actual opened image/video frames or tutorial original text. Clearly separate visible operation, actual spoken words, photographer-stated reason, project inference and unknown conditions. Videos need reproducible timestamps and actual pixels for visual claims; transcripts alone establish only words. No fabricated dialogue, wrong URL, cross-file equipment contradiction, unsupported exact mechanics/angles/settings or invented motive/causality.
criteria.evidence: Verifier personally inspects selected original pixels and original words supporting high-impact claims; retain private screenshots/frame locators and a claim ledger. No visual PASS solely from another agent self-assessment or synthetic test.

criteria.requirement: Previously unexplained new-scenario judgment exercises require choosing a goal, diagnosing evidence, giving a concrete direction and predicting outcome/tradeoff. They cannot merely ask learners to repeat a demonstrated answer. Questions and folded analyses support thinking before reveal; include short real-shoot practice and a review method.
criteria.evidence: Compare exercise scenarios with all preceding explanation/cases, inspect reveal behavior and close-read analysis for conditional choices.

criteria.requirement: A real AGY CLI call polishes the whole module after factual/content draft formation, with actual argv/cwd/PID/start/end/exit or denied-tool evidence; Codex may not simulate AGY. Preserve before text, after text and actual diff. Final factual audit checks additions, removed conditions, dialogue/settings and causal changes; unsupported changes must be verified, removed or directed back.
criteria.evidence: Inspect original AGY process/tool log, complete before/after artifacts, independently compute/check diff and compare final course with audited version. Polish quality alone is not factual proof.

criteria.requirement: Actual desktop browser opens, reads full course, navigates chapters, views important cases/source locators, expands and collapses analyses, closes/reopens and moves to linked skills without uncaught errors, inaccessible text or broken navigation.
criteria.evidence: Independent browser execution with screenshots, error capture and navigation observations; broken media must retain useful text, attribution and original-source fallback.

criteria.requirement: Actual narrow mobile viewport supports the same reading/case/analysis/navigation path with readable text and controls, no horizontal page overflow or content hidden by fixed layers; chapters and important source links remain reachable.
criteria.evidence: Independent browser at approximately 390px width; inspect first/middle/end content and actual expanded analyses/media fallback.

criteria.requirement: This course has questions and folded analyses only, with no answer fields, self-rating forms or save-answer buttons. Reading, reveal, chapter/skill navigation, reopen and reload cause no learning-state mutations, personal-skill promotion or reference-library changes.
criteria.evidence: Independent DOM inspection plus browser network write capture and before/after seeded isolated private-record comparison; never test against owner's daily data.

criteria.requirement: Existing sword course, previous gateways, skill index, sources, private learning records and stale-revision behavior remain compatible. Map existing character-4, posing-6 and character-1 to actual canonical skills and associate additional skills only when content supports them; no parallel taxonomy or needless node expansion.
criteria.evidence: Inspect baseline/candidate catalogue relation and fingerprints, run relevant validators/build checks, open old course and old gateway, exercise existing-state roundtrip/conflict with isolated data.

criteria.requirement: No unauthorized original videos, commercial tutorial images, private photos, runtime data, browser profiles or secrets enter tracked changes. Display/embedding and redistribution permission remain distinct; legal-access blocks stay visible. No paid API, global permission bypass, global Skill/Hook change, production release or main merge is introduced.
criteria.evidence: Scoped final diff/status and provenance/rights review; local evidence retained in ignored .local, without printing credentials.

criteria.requirement: Candidate executes applicable syntax, catalogue/source/content validators, canonical build/check and affected reader/state regressions with actual commands/results; required project default regression runs or precise blockers are reported. New tests prove actual failure modes, not only mirrored implementation or synthetic photographic correctness.
criteria.evidence: Independent commands in verifier candidate worktree using root repo .venv/Scripts/python.exe and isolated worktree .local data. Historical reports and implementation test suggestions do not pass.

criteria.requirement: Factual collaboration report records actual AGY/CC invocation counts, successes/failures/access limits, material each actually read, independent corrections, CC code changes, genuine verifier defects and at most two directed revision rounds, observed polish improvements and introduced-error handling. No speed/cost/quality causal comparison without comparable baseline.
criteria.evidence: Cross-check final report with original process/tool records, diffs and independent findings; never manufacture defects to demonstrate collaboration.

criteria.requirement: Engineering behavior, source/visual verification and human learning/aesthetic acceptance are reported separately. Passing pytest does not mean user learned directing. Owner trial-learning/refilm feedback remains pending; publication is root-only and Git/Notion outcomes remain distinct from acceptance.
criteria.evidence: Independent acceptance report states actual verified scope, unverified human outcome, limitations, runnable regression and accessible local course entry.
